GameConditionDef.label: the Settling
GameConditionDef.description: The wind has dropped and the old war's dust is coming down out of the air. Anything not under a roof is slowly poisoned, and a pale film is laying itself over every open cell, thickest in the crater bowls. Every footprint made in it stays until the wind comes back and the ground forgets.
GameConditionDef.startMessage: The wind has dropped. The Settling begins.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The wind is back. The ground forgets.
